champion.tips: LEE SIN TIPS AND TRICKS Just because you landed your Q on the enemy, it doesn’t mean you have to follow up and go in! Using your Flash in conjunction with your Ultimate R to kick a squishy carry into your team could be a great way of winning a team fight. Keeping the minion wave slightly closer to your side of the map in the early parts of the game could offer you more trading opportunities.
champion.builds: THE BEST LEE SIN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Lee Sin Mid build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Sudden Impact and Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Eclipse as your first item, followed by Mercury's Treads and Sundered Sky. For your last 3 items, you should build Death's Dance, Maw of Malmortius and finish with Black Cleaver. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 54.2% winrate over 107 matches played. Optional Your second option for Lee Sin Mid build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Sudden Impact with Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Ravenous Hydra, which you should build first, followed by Mercury's Treads as your second item and Eclipse as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Black Cleaver, Sundered Sky and Death's Dance. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 52.9% win rate over 85 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, and Second Wind with Revitalize in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Eclipse as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Profane Hydra as a third item. You want to finish the build with Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night and Serpent's Fang. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 46.6% win rate across 58 matches played. Situational Lee Sin Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Lee Sin build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Lee Sin runes page.
